hints.title: Four Directional Recurrence Relations
hints.text: A consecutive line of ones can extend horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or anti-diagonally.

hints.title: Four-State Directional DP State
hints.text: Store four lengths per cell corresponding to the four ray directions, extending from the preceding neighbor when cell value is one.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Matrix Update
hints.text: For cell (r, c) with value one: horizontal adds from (r, c-1), vertical from (r-1, c), diagonal from (r-1, c-1), anti-diagonal from (r-1, c+1). Track overall maximum across all four values.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(M * N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all four directions from each cell independently requires repeated redundant cell visits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching the 4-way direction counts per cell evaluates each entry in constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle boundaries for anti-diagonal lookup (c+1 < n) carefully.
